prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” lawyer for every Atlanta car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, the injuries, your goals, and how you like to work with a lawyer. I can, however, tell you how to find the best match and offer to produce a short, vetted list if you tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood.

Immediate practical steps (if you haven’t already)
- Seek medical attention and follow treatment — medical records are critical.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of the scene/vehicles, contact info for witnesses, police report number.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other side’s insurer until you’ve talked with a lawyer.  
- Note deadlines: under Georgia law most personal-injury claims must be filed within 2 years of the crash (there are exceptions).

How to identify a top Atlanta car-accident lawyer
Look for attorneys who consistently demonstrate:
- Substantial auto-accident experience (not only general PI).  
- Trial experience and a track record of settlements and verdicts in similar cases.  
- Good client reviews and peer ratings (Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers).  
- Memberships/recognitions (e.g., Georgia Trial Lawyers Association).  
- Clear contingency-fee terms and transparent billing for costs.  
- Good communication: responsiveness and willingness to explain strategy.

Where to search and verify
- State Bar of Georgia website: verify license and disciplinary history.  
- Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers for ratings and reviews.  
- Google/YC/Nextdoor for local client reviews.  
- Court records (PACER/local dockets) for trial/settlement history.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?  
- How many of those went to trial and what were typical outcomes?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (partner/associate)?  
- What is your fee (contingency %), and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- How do you communicate (phone/email) and how often will I get updates?  
- Can you provide client references or sample verdicts/settlements?

Typical fee and timeline expectations
- Contingency fees commonly around 33%–40% if the attorney settles before suit; higher if suit or appeal is required.  
- Cases often take months to years depending on injury severity, treatment completion, and litigation.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short, vetted list of Atlanta personal-injury attorneys based on ratings and experience if you give your ZIP code or neighborhood.  
- Draft a short script or email you can use to contact lawyers and schedule consultations.  
- Help you evaluate proposals after you get a few consultations.

Which would you like me to do next? (If you want a shortlist, tell me the ZIP or the part of Atlanta you’re in and any preferences — e.g., large firm vs. boutique, trial-focused, language needs.)
